activity_summary: You walked the market with a twin on each hand until they tired of hands. Butter was fourpence, and the woman said it had been threepence at Michaelmas. Richard nodded from behind the glove stall and kept selling. Quiney took your hand in both of his, said London agrees with you, and asked nothing. Judith repeated loving countryman in his voice. You told Hamnet not to laugh, and he did.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the hands, paid fourpence, and took the greeting.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the hands and the price from becoming a reception.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Tired of hands, ran, and laughed once after being told not to.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept her hand longer, and repeated Quiney's words in his voice.

entities.name: Richard Quiney
entities.context: Took William's hand in both of his, asked nothing, and left the phrase behind.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Nodded from behind the stall, and went on selling.

facets.activity: Took Quiney's greeting and let Hamnet laugh once

quotes.speaker: (the butter-woman)
quotes.text: Fourpence. It was threepence at Michaelmas

quotes.speaker: richard_quiney
quotes.text: Loving countryman! London agrees with you.

quotes.speaker: judith_shakespeare
quotes.text: Loving countryman. I have it in his voice

quotes.speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am laughing. You told me not to, and I am.
